posts.name: Yak Guardian
posts.cooked:
When the OblivAeon Kickstarter began, I was surprised to learn that most people were just tossing the art prints in the trash.

Is that really the case?

Personally, I still have all of them. Most of them are in sheet protectors serving as dividers for verious Sentinels documents (Spiff's awesome Rules & Clarifications doc, some scenario rules, some personal Sentinels docs). One of them (one of my two copies of Quando Ahora!) is hanging in my cubicle at work, awaiting a frame that won't be in the budget until sometime after OblivAeon is paid for.

I just can't imagine just tossing them. (Except maybe the one of Greazer. That's just a weird choice for an art print. But I even kept both of those.)
